name: SyncerD
description: Install and run the SyncerD CLI: sync (Docker registry mirroring) or git-sync (git repository mirroring).
helpMarkDown: Installs syncerd from GitHub Releases, adds it to PATH, and optionally runs a syncerd command: `sync` mirrors Docker images between registries, `git-sync` mirrors git repositories between hosting providers.
author: CloudDrove

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: SyncerD version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of syncerd to install. Use `latest` or a release tag such as `v0.0.11`.

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Command
inputs.helpMarkDown: SyncerD command and arguments to run after installation. Leave blank to install only. Use `sync ...` to mirror Docker images, or `git-sync ...` to mirror git repositories; both accept the same `--config`, `--once`, `--report`, `--metrics-file`, and `--log-format` flags, and `git-sync` additionally accepts `--dry-run`.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory where the syncerd command runs.
